name: Hulkling, Young Avenger — copy "except his name is Hulkling, he's 4/4, and he has flying and this ability"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). The gendered pronouns of a copy exception are rewritten to "this card is / this card has" before the copy parser sees them, and the P/T exception only matched "it's N/N", while "has this ability" did not allow keywords in front of it ("has flying and this ability"). Copying Shivan Dragon gave a 5/5 that could not change shape again. Now it is a 4/4 Dragon named Hulkling with the Dragon's abilities, flying and its own trigger.

$includes: {R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this card becomes a copy of up to one other target creature until end of turn, except his name is this card, he's 4/4, and he has flying and this ability.
